comments.body: Don't make it complicated. Try to study very hard in the first two semesters. Once you get used to the study culture, the rest is piece of cake. My advice to you is 1) no need to be scared 2) don't screw up the first year 3) be in the survival mode for the first couple if months, you will find time later to have fun. Good luck
comments.author: useless_neutrino
